decision.title: Choose authentication approach
decision.summary: Use OAuth instead of storing passwords?
decision.rationale: A managed identity provider avoids building and securing custom password storage in the first version.

research_report.summary: SCRIPTED DEMO: Recommend OAuth over password storage (confidence medium).

pages.title: Recommendation
pages.content:
Recommendation: adopt OAuth via a managed identity provider.
Confidence: medium. Uncertainty: provider availability and token refresh ergonomics.
Alternatives considered:
- OAuth (managed): external identity dependency, no password storage to secure.
- Email/password: full control, but ongoing security maintenance and breach surface.
This is scripted demo data (source_mode=demo).

code_diff_v1.summary: SCRIPTED DEMO: add oauth_login scaffold (+18 / -1 across 2 files).

pages.title: oauth_login.py
pages.content:
--- a/oauth_login.py
+++ b/oauth_login.py
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+"""OAuth login scaffold."""
+
+def authorize_url(provider, redirect_uri):
+    return f"https://auth.example.com/{provider}/authorize?redirect_uri={redirect_uri}"
+
+def start_oauth_login(provider):
+    return {"provider": provider, "url": authorize_url(provider, "app://callback")}

code_diff_fix.summary: SCRIPTED DEMO: carry redirect_uri through start_oauth_login (+3 / -2).

pages.title: oauth_login.py (fix)
pages.content:
--- a/oauth_login.py
+++ b/oauth_login.py
@@ -6,3 +6,4 @@
-def start_oauth_login(provider):
-    return {"provider": provider, "url": authorize_url(provider, "app://callback")}
+def start_oauth_login(provider, redirect_uri="app://callback"):
+    url = authorize_url(provider, redirect_uri)
+    return {"provider": provider, "url": url, "redirect_uri": redirect_uri}
